findings.detail: The rate-fill warning is driven by direct-lending rows where the filer explicitly reports Interest Rate as N/A(6), not by a missing rate in the raw source.

rationale: The flagged metric is aggregate rate fill for direct-lending rows. Raw SOI tables expose Interest Rate as a dedicated column; funded rows in the same schedule carry numeric rates, while many flagged-style rows are explicitly printed as N/A(6) with no principal and zero or negative carrying/fair-value amounts. Bundle examples with blank extracted rates, including ABC Legal Holdings and Action Termite Control, match source rows whose Interest Rate cell is N/A(6). The source therefore supports leaving these rates blank and indicates the weak rate-fill check is over-scoped for N/A/unfunded-style direct-lending rows rather than identifying a data extraction error.
